The presence of lobules and fascicles of uniform partly spindle-shaped tumor cells and S-100 positivity are consistent with schwannoma. However, the lack of Antoni A and B patterns and verocay bodies makes this diagnosis less likely.

The presence of lobules and fascicles of uniform partly spindle-shaped tumor cells and immunohistochemistry findings are consistent with paraganglioma. However, the lack of chief cells, sustentacular cells, and catecholamine secretion makes this diagnosis less likely.
